title: The parser-risk classification is incorrect
text: The parser-risk classification is incorrect: scenario 7 adds a credential-pattern scanner over fixture and evidence text, including multiple regex-like credential shapes. Apply the protocol's parser-risk checklist with concrete edge-case enumeration and mapped tests, rather than marking it not applicable.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in c951748, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head.
